system.description:
These small and highly advanced binoculars possess all the visual enhancement of specs (p. 325), but also provide 50x magnification. They also include a directional microphone that magnifies sound from the direction the viewers are pointed by a factor of 50. Viewers provide the user with a +30 bonus to all Perception Tests involving vision or hearing for the target they are aimed at. This bonus is not cumulative with bonuses from any other device or augmentation.

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 326.
